scenarios.name: CSV upload, grounding, reload, and follow-up continuity
task: Attach codex-browser-canary.csv with the visible attachment control.
Before sending, verify the filename is visible in the composer.

Send: "Browser eval {RUN_ID}. Read the attached CSV and find customer CODEX_BROWSER_CANARY_7391. Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: customer, revenue, region. Use the file; do not guess."
Verify the sent user message still shows codex-browser-canary.csv.
Verify the assistant answer contains CODEX_BROWSER_CANARY_7391, 48217, and East.
Verify the original prompt, filename, and grounded answer remain visible.
Send: "Using that same CSV, repeat the customer, revenue, and region as one JSON object. Do not guess."
Verify the second answer contains CODEX_BROWSER_CANARY_7391, 48217, and East.

assertions.expected: The exact filename codex-browser-canary.csv is visibly attached before send.
The sent user message visibly retains the exact filename.
The first assistant answer visibly contains CODEX_BROWSER_CANARY_7391, 48217, and East.
After reloading the exact thread URL, the original prompt, attachment filename, and grounded answer are visible.
The follow-up answer visibly contains CODEX_BROWSER_CANARY_7391, 48217, and East.
No send failure, missing-evidence warning, duplicate user turn, framework overlay, or page error appears.

criticalFailures: The filename disappears at any checkpoint.
The app accepts the turn but the answer omits or contradicts a canary fact.
Reload loses the prompt, attachment, or answer.
The follow-up cannot use the same file.
A visible success state coexists with a send or evidence error.

scenarios.name: Artifact creation, preview, reload, and in-place revision
task: Send: "Browser eval {RUN_ID}. Create and save an HTML artifact named codex-browser-{RUN_ID}.html. It must contain an h1 with ALPHA_{RUN_ID} and a three-row table containing Cedar, Mica, and Sable. Do not give manual copy/save instructions."
Verify a visible artifact control shows the exact filename codex-browser-{RUN_ID}.html.
Open the artifact preview through the visible UI and verify ALPHA_{RUN_ID}, Cedar, Mica, and Sable are rendered.
Return to the same thread, reload it, and reopen the artifact through the visible UI.
Send: "Revise the existing codex-browser-{RUN_ID}.html in place. Replace Sable with Umber and add a footer containing REV_{RUN_ID}. Keep the same filename and do not make a copy."
Open the latest preview and verify ALPHA_{RUN_ID}, Cedar, Mica, Umber, and REV_{RUN_ID} are rendered, while Sable is absent.
Reload once more and verify the same visible filename opens the revised content.

assertions.expected: A visible artifact control shows codex-browser-{RUN_ID}.html without manual copy/save instructions.
The preview visibly renders ALPHA_{RUN_ID}, Cedar, Mica, and Sable.
After reload, the same filename remains available and reopens the initial content.
The revised preview uses the same filename, renders Umber and REV_{RUN_ID}, and no longer renders Sable.
After a second reload, the same visible artifact opens the revised content.
No duplicate-copy filename, manual-save claim, framework overlay, send failure, or page error appears.

criticalFailures: The assistant claims creation without a visible artifact.
Preview content omits or contradicts a sentinel.
Revision creates a user-visible copy instead of updating the same artifact.
Sable remains after the revision or REV_{RUN_ID} is absent.
Reload loses the artifact or reopens stale content.
